title: TrueForge: Open-Source Agent Harness That Turns LLMs Into Working Agents
description:
TrueForge is a free, open-source agent harness that handles the execution loop for your AI agents — model calls, tools, sandboxing, and memory — out of the box. Run it locally or deploy for teams.
